name: com.lingkyn.haptics.unity
description: Thin Unity adapter for the Lingkyn Haptics Core: explicit target resolution from Core HapticTargets to XR Interaction Toolkit haptic impulse channels and OpenXR haptic actions through an explicit, injected route map, with an Input System rumble fallback route; an injectable IHapticOutputSink with a recording fake for tests so an accepted play/stop/stop_all outcome's exact target, amplitude, duration, and frequency can be asserted without a device; HapticProfileAsset ScriptableObjects constructed with explicit references and converted deterministically to the Core's immutable HapticProfile; envelope playback degrading to a transient with a diagnostic when the runtime lacks the amplitude-envelope extension; and explicit, LESSON-004 fail-closed diagnostics for every by-name or optional resolution.
